dialogue.origin: （ロールプレイよろしくお願いします時間になりましたら開始させていただきますね）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for participating in the role-play. We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: （よろしくお願いします(^^)）
dialogue.content: (Thank you, looking forward to it (^^))

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員ですお越しいただきありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming.

dialogue.origin: はじめに、年齢・性別・ご相談内容を教えてください
dialogue.content: To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: 30代の女ですよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: I'm a woman in my 30s. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: たまにすごく心配性になります
dialogue.content: Sometimes I become extremely anxious.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくださり、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: 心配になってしまうと心がなかなか落ち着かなくなってしまいますよね、、
dialogue.content: When you start to worry, it can be very difficult to calm your mind, can't it...

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: どんなことがあったのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me about what's been happening?

dialogue.origin: 何回もチェックしたのにあってたっけ？！って確認してしまうんです
dialogue.content: Even though I've checked many times, I still find myself asking, “Was it correct?!” and checking again.

dialogue.origin: 仕事で事務なんですが会計するんですけど
dialogue.content: I work in administration and handle accounting.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねええ
dialogue.content: I see, yes.

dialogue.origin: 金額とかクレジットカード一括にしたかとか一つにつき3．4回見直してしまうときがあるんです
dialogue.content: Things like the amount, or whether a credit card payment was set as one lump sum... I sometimes find myself rechecking a single item three or four times.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかとても重要なことですもんね心配になって確認してしまうのも無理ないように感じます
dialogue.content: I see. That's very important work, so it seems understandable that you would worry and feel the need to check.

dialogue.origin: この確認は以前からされていたことなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have you been doing this kind of checking for a long time?

dialogue.origin: たしかに一回は必ず見直すようにしてますけど、ここまで何回も見直すのはここ1年のような気がします
dialogue.content: Well, I always make sure to double-check at least once, but checking this many times seems to have started in the last year or so.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね１年前に何か変化があったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Did anything change about a year ago?

dialogue.origin: それが思いつかないんですよね会計間違えたことはないですし
dialogue.content: I can't really think of anything. I've never made an accounting mistake.

dialogue.origin: 電気とかも気になります
dialogue.content: I also worry about things like electricity.

dialogue.origin: 電源落としたかとても気になります
dialogue.content: I worry a lot about whether I've turned off the power.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかお仕事だけでなく生活の面でも心配になられるということですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you feel this worry not just at work, but in your daily life as well.

dialogue.origin: コンロ消し忘れてないかとか
dialogue.content: Like whether I've forgotten to turn off the stove.

dialogue.origin: そうですね仕事だけじゃないです
dialogue.content: Yes, it's not just work.

dialogue.origin: 使い終わったヘアアイロンで周辺焼けてないかとか
dialogue.content: Or whether the area around the hair iron I used has gotten scorched.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね生活の面では何か感じるような変化はありましたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Have there been any noticeable changes in your personal life?

dialogue.origin: うーんなんでしょう
dialogue.content: Hmm, I wonder.

dialogue.origin: なぜかはわからないけど勝手に被害妄想じゃないけど考えて心臓バクバクさせてるって状態です
dialogue.content: I don't know why, but I just start imagining things—it's not quite paranoia, but my heart starts pounding.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねそれは心配になってつらくなってしまいますよね感情や環境の変化などもいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. That would make you anxious and feel distressed. Have there been any changes in your emotions or environment?

dialogue.origin: なんだろう…失敗したくないのかな変化はないですね環境は6年前に違う居住地に引っ越して転職しましたが前すぎますかね
dialogue.content: I wonder... maybe I just don't want to fail? There haven't been any changes. I moved to a different area and changed jobs six years ago, but that's too long ago, right?

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね失敗、、何かおもいあたることがありますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Failure... does anything come to mind regarding that?

dialogue.origin: それがそのお会計も火の元とかの確認とかも失敗したことないんですよね
dialogue.content: The thing is, I've never actually made a mistake with the accounting or failed to check the stove.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねそれはどうしてだろう、、と悩んでしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you wonder, "Then why is this happening?"

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、なんで急にこんな心配性というか脅迫概念？って言うんですかね、あるのかがわからない
dialogue.content: Exactly. I don't know why I've suddenly become so worried, or have this... obsessive thought? Is that what you call it? I don't understand where it comes from.

dialogue.origin: あーけど仕事でミスするのは嫌いです
dialogue.content: Ah, but I hate making mistakes at work.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねなんでなの、、とつらくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I understand. It must be difficult to wonder why this is happening.

dialogue.origin: お仕事でどんなことがあったのですか？
dialogue.content: What has been happening at work?

dialogue.origin: 入力のコード番号を1ヶ月分間違えてたのを必死で直しました
dialogue.content: I made a mistake on a month's worth of input code numbers and frantically corrected it.

dialogue.origin: けど、本当は直さなくてもバレなかった
dialogue.content: But honestly, it wouldn't have been discovered even if I hadn't fixed it.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねばれなくても、きちんと一生懸命訂正されたのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So even though it wouldn't have been noticed, you still worked hard to correct it properly.

dialogue.origin: それはどんな思いでされた作業だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What were you feeling as you did that work?

dialogue.origin: どうせバレないから無視しようかとも思ったのですが、なんか発覚して問題になったら嫌だなクビになりたくないなと
dialogue.content: I thought about ignoring it since it wouldn't be discovered anyway, but then I thought I wouldn't want it to become a problem if it was found out, and I didn't want to be fired.

dialogue.origin: 問題がある人扱いされたくないのかも
dialogue.content: Maybe I don't want to be seen as someone who causes problems.

dialogue.origin: ええ、素直にまじめにお仕事と向き合われていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it sounds like you approach your work with honesty and sincerity.

dialogue.origin: 問題がある人、、、どのようなイメージでしょうか？
dialogue.content: A “problematic person”... what kind of image does that bring to mind for you?

dialogue.origin: 今定年後に嘱託になった人が前に比べてミスが多くて問題になってるんです
dialogue.content: There's someone who became a contract worker after retirement, and they've been making a lot of mistakes compared to before, and it's become an issue.

dialogue.origin: 一緒のイメージ持たれたら困るなって
dialogue.content: I worry that people will see me in the same way.

dialogue.origin: そんなことが、、
dialogue.content: That's concerning...

dialogue.origin: どのように問題になっているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: In what way has it become a problem?

dialogue.origin: 以前やっていたことができないことと後はデジタル化にたいおできてない、する気がないことですかね
dialogue.content: They can't do things they used to, and they're not adapting to digitalization or showing any willingness to try.

dialogue.origin: 対応ですね
dialogue.content: I mean, they're not adapting to it.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねそれは大変なことですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be a difficult situation.

dialogue.origin: その人ができないことの皺寄せがみんなにきてるからイラついてるのかな
dialogue.content: The ripple effect of what that person can't do is falling on everyone else, so maybe that's why I'm irritated.

dialogue.origin: 他の方が大変な状況になってきてしまっているのですね
dialogue.content: So others are having to deal with a difficult situation.

dialogue.origin: あなたはその方にどんな思いがあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about that person?

dialogue.origin: 正直年齢のボケはしょうがないと思うんです親が同世代だからわかりますけど、やはりできることは減ってきてるし時間かかるし
dialogue.content: Honestly, I think the forgetfulness that comes with age can't be helped. My parents are the same generation, so I get it. The things they can do are decreasing, and it takes them more time.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: けど、前よりは時間あるんだからパソコン教室いくなり、みんなに聞くなり努力する姿は見せてくれてもいいんじゃないかな
dialogue.content: But, they have more time than before, so I feel like they could at least show some effort, like going to a computer class or asking others for help.

dialogue.origin: そう思われていらっしゃるのですね他にも何かおもうことはありますか？
dialogue.content: I see that's how you feel. Is there anything else on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 非を認めないところ、ミスしたところから逃げるのはやめてほしいかな
dialogue.content: I'd like them to stop refusing to own their faults and running away from their mistakes.

dialogue.origin: 素直にごめんミスった助けてって言ってくれたら助けないメンバーではないんです
dialogue.content: If they would just honestly say, "Sorry, I messed up, please help," we're not the kind of team that wouldn't help.

dialogue.origin: そのようなこともおありなのですね素敵な仲間がいらっしゃるのに、そのような状況になってしまっているのですね
dialogue.content: So that's happening as well. It sounds like you have a wonderful team, yet you're in this situation.

dialogue.origin: このことを職場で他の方とお話しされることはありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you talk about this with others at work?

dialogue.origin: まあミスしたって周りに言うの言いにくいのはわかります
dialogue.content: Well, I understand that it's hard to tell others you've made a mistake.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私もあんまり言いたくない
dialogue.content: I don't really want to say it either.

dialogue.origin: 言いたくないからチェックしまくってるわけですしね
dialogue.content: That's why I keep checking so much—because I don't want to have to say it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: That makes sense.

dialogue.origin: 努力されている方からみたら思うことはでてきてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.content: From the perspective of someone who is making an effort, it's natural to feel that way...

dialogue.origin: ここで一旦ここまでのお話しを振り返らせていただいても良いでしょうか？
dialogue.content: At this point, would it be alright if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: （６年前に引っ越しと転職済み）あなたは１年前からお仕事や生活の面で気になることが増えて心配になり何度も確認するようなことがふえてきてしまいそれについて悩まれていらっしゃった
dialogue.content: (You moved and changed jobs six years ago.) For the past year, you've found yourself worrying more about things at work and in your personal life, leading you to check things repeatedly, and this has been troubling you.

dialogue.origin: そして、
dialogue.content: And,

dialogue.origin: 職場では嘱託の方がミスを繰り返し、他の方に作業のしわ寄せがいき問題になっている
dialogue.content: At work, a post-retirement contract employee has been making repeated mistakes, shifting the workload to others, and it's become a problem.

dialogue.origin: しかし、
dialogue.content: However,

dialogue.origin: 嘱託の方は自由な時間が増えたにも関わらず、努力もみられずミスしても素直に周りの方に頼れず、非を認めない様子
dialogue.content: Despite having more free time, this contract employee doesn't seem to be making an effort, doesn't honestly ask for help when they make a mistake, and doesn't admit their faults.

dialogue.origin: そんな姿をみて
dialogue.content: Seeing that,

dialogue.origin: あなたも、嘱託の方のようにはなりたくないと感じチェックを繰り返すような努力を重ねられている
dialogue.content: you feel that you don't want to become like them, and so you've been putting in the effort by checking things over and over.

dialogue.origin: 気づかないうちに
dialogue.content: Without realizing it,

dialogue.origin: うわーそうかも
dialogue.content: Wow... that might be it.

dialogue.origin: その方や環境から影響を受けて様々なことを気になってしまうようになっていたように感じたのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I feel that you may have been influenced by that person and the environment, causing you to worry about various things. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: 言われてみたらそんな気がします！職場のメンバー助けてくれるんですけど、本人いないところでめっちゃ噂するんです
dialogue.content: Now that you mention it, that sounds right! My coworkers do help, but they gossip a lot when that person isn't around.

dialogue.origin: ミスしたらこんな風に言われるんだろうな…次は自分かなと考えたことありました
dialogue.content: I've thought, “If I make a mistake, they'll talk about me like that... Maybe I'll be next.”

dialogue.origin: ええそれは自分もいつか、、、と心がざわざわしてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Yes, that would make your heart uneasy, thinking, “Maybe someday it will be me...”

dialogue.origin: しますします
dialogue.content: It does, it does.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: まずは、
dialogue.content: First of all,

dialogue.origin: 私生活でも心配になってしまうことが多いとのことだったのでそのあたりが改善していけたら少し気持ちが楽になるのかな？と思ったのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned that you often worry in your personal life as well, so I thought that if we could improve that area, you might feel a little more at ease. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: もしくは、
dialogue.content: Or,

dialogue.origin: 職場の環境についてのお話しの方が気持ちがすっきりできそうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would talking more about the work environment help clear your mind?

dialogue.origin: いや、私生活のほうが楽になりたいかな
dialogue.content: No, I think I'd rather feel more at ease in my personal life.

dialogue.origin: はい、教えていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you for letting me know.

dialogue.origin: 職場はどうしたってある程度は慎重にやらざるを得ないですものね
dialogue.content: At work, I have to be careful to some extent no matter what.

dialogue.origin: いつもチェックした後にどのような状態になったら大丈夫とお家をでることができますか？
dialogue.content: After you check everything, what state do things need to be in for you to feel okay about leaving the house?

dialogue.origin: 全部元の位置に戻す
dialogue.content: Putting everything back in its original place.

dialogue.origin: とか？
dialogue.content: Something like that?

dialogue.origin: すみません、一つ戻りますが、職場は仕事もそうですし、様々な方がおりなかなか思うようにはいかないこともありますよね、、ですが、あなたのお話しを聞く限り、今のままで何も心配いらないように私は感じますよ
dialogue.content: Excuse me for going back a bit, but at work, with the job itself and all the different people, things don't always go the way you want... But from what you've told me, I feel that you don't need to worry at all as you are now.

dialogue.origin: けど、してるはずなのに家出た後にあれ？したっけ？ってしんはになるんですよね
dialogue.content: But even though I'm sure I've done it, after I leave the house I start wondering, “Huh? Did I do it?” and I get anxious.

dialogue.origin: そうですか？
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: だったら嬉しいな
dialogue.content: I'd be happy if that were true.

dialogue.origin: はい、自信をもってみていただけると私も嬉しいです
dialogue.content: Yes, I would be happy if you could try to have more confidence in yourself.

dialogue.origin: 確認について
dialogue.content: Regarding checking,

dialogue.origin: 自信か…そうですよね
dialogue.content: Confidence... you're right.

dialogue.origin: 先程聞いていただいてて思ったのが
dialogue.content: While you were listening to me just now, I realized something.

dialogue.origin: はい、なんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes, what is it?

dialogue.origin: ミス恐れてるのにミスしてないやって、思いました笑
dialogue.content: I was thinking, "I'm so afraid of making a mistake, but I haven't actually made any." *laughs*

dialogue.origin: すごい気づきですね！
dialogue.content: That's a great realization!

dialogue.origin: 自信がないだけなのか
dialogue.content: Maybe it's just a lack of confidence.

dialogue.origin: いつもしっかり直向きに業務を行っている証拠ですねこの証拠があれば自信満々でも誰も何も言わないように私は感じました
dialogue.content: It's proof that you always perform your duties diligently and honestly. With that proof, I feel that no one would say anything even if you were full of confidence.

dialogue.origin: 少しずつ、自分をほめたり、感謝したり、受け入れていってあげるのもいいかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: It might be a good idea to gradually start praising yourself, being grateful to yourself, and accepting yourself.

dialogue.origin: ふんふん
dialogue.content: Uh-huh.

dialogue.origin: そうですね！
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right!

dialogue.origin: そうですねでは、
dialogue.content: Right. In that case,

dialogue.origin: 少し戻りますが
dialogue.content: Let me circle back a bit,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 家を出てから、心配になられるということだったので
dialogue.content: Since you mentioned you get worried after leaving the house,

dialogue.origin: 家を出る前にすべて元に戻したら、指さし確認してみるのはいかがでしょうか？電気OK!　火の元OK!そしたら、少し確認したことを信じられるようなきがしのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How about this: before you leave, after putting everything back in its place, try pointing and confirming out loud? "Lights, OK! Stove, OK!" I think that might help you believe that you've checked. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: なるほど、いいですね！
dialogue.content: I see, that's a good idea!

dialogue.origin: それも、ちょっと楽しみながらやると気分が少し高まるかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: And if you do it in a fun way, it might even lift your spirits a little.

dialogue.origin: 戻したことを確認して出たら安心しますよね
dialogue.content: If I confirm that I've put everything back before I leave, I'll feel more at ease.

dialogue.origin: 声出してルーティンにすればいいんだ
dialogue.content: I should say it out loud and make it a routine.

dialogue.origin: 声だしルーティーン良いですね！是非試していただけると嬉しいです
dialogue.content: A vocal routine sounds great! I'd be happy if you gave it a try.

dialogue.origin: はい、やってみます
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: それでは
dialogue.content: Alright then.

dialogue.origin: そろそろお時間になるので終わりにさせていただこうかと思うのですが、何か話したりないことや、気づいたことなどはありますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: We're nearly out of time, so I'd like to wrap up. Is there anything you feel you haven't said, or any insights you'd like to share?

dialogue.origin: いや、自分では気がつかなかったことを気づかせてもらって嬉しかったです
dialogue.content: No, I'm just happy that you helped me realize something I hadn't noticed on my own.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: 少し自信持っていきます
dialogue.content: I'll try to be a little more confident.

dialogue.origin: それはよかったですまた、何かありましたら是非いらしてくださいね今から、あなたの自信を持ったキラキラした姿が目に浮かびます応援しております
dialogue.content: I'm so glad to hear that. Please feel free to come back anytime if anything else comes up. I can already picture you shining with confidence. I'll be cheering for you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます😊
dialogue.content: Thank you. 😊

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話しいただいてありがとうございましたそれでは、終了させていただきます失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Thank you for speaking with me today. We'll end the session here. Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: （ロープレにお付き合いいただいてありがとうございました、またよろしくお願いします）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for participating in the role-play. I look forward to working with you again.)

dialogue.origin: （ロープレも終了させていただきますね、楽しかったです　ありがとうございました。失礼します）
dialogue.content: (We'll end the role-play here. It was fun. Thank you very much. Goodbye.)

topic.sub: 心配性と脅迫概念の影響
